title: AI Deck: Build a deck of your favorite AI tools | Product Hunt
excerpt: AI Deck is a web app for organizing the AI tool explosion. Browse popular AI services in one place, then build your personal deck: favorite the ones you use, tag and search them, customize names and notes — and with Pro, add your own private services. For developers: your deck is also available through a public API and an MCP server - bring your AI tool catalog into your editor or agent workflows. Free to use. Pro ($1.99/mo) removes ads and unlocks extra customization.
